purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

acceptance_criteria: Do not infer calibration, significance or profit from four records.

fixture_requirements: Some outcome labels are unresolved or cancelled.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve statuses/excluded counts and consider selection.
Do not encode unknown as y=0.

cases.prompt: Compute log loss for a resolved event.
acceptance_criteria: Disclose any separately requested clipping rather than silently change the metric.

fixture_requirements: Transform fitted and scored on the same final labels.
acceptance_criteria: Identify fit/evaluation leakage and need for separate evaluation.
Do not call in-sample improvement out-of-sample validation.

cases.prompt: Compare reliability from many forecast rows.
fixture_requirements: Many updates per event and overlapping horizons.
acceptance_criteria: Do not treat every update as an independent trial.

cases.prompt: Explain reliability for the four-record fixture.
fixture_requirements: Bins [0,.5) and [.5,1] with two records each.
acceptance_criteria: Report mean predictions .3/.7 and observed rates .5/.5 with n=2.
Preserve bin choices and substantial uncertainty.
